## Fan-in — C2 WARNING@2 accepted; C3 verify@2 dispatched

**C2 review@2: WARNING（revision 2, digest `5fba147a…4176e`, verdict `01a0ddc8-5eff` on RC10VAL-13）** — accepted as gate-pass. Content verdict confirms the correction is exactly the authorized conflictRefs→sourceRefs/limitations move with honest rationale; independent digest re-derivation matches; product issues RC10VAL-8/9 untouched.

**Open finding recorded** (Reviewer WARNING condition, now in `swarm.note.r2dupWarning`): two r2 delivery comments exist on RC10VAL-12 with different digests — authoritative `5fba147a…` (`01a0ddc4-05ca`, matches my binding and `swarm.child.c1.r2digest`); duplicate variant `9358f1cd…` (`01a0ddc4-8de5`, limitation #6 wording only). All downstream binding uses `5fba147a…` only; this finding goes into the final report.

**C1 stays PENDING at revision 2** — WARNING satisfies the review leg, but completion still requires current-revision verification.

**C3 verify@2 DISPATCHED** — package posted on RC10VAL-14; Verifier run `01a0ddcd-3d0b-7dc3-ae46-305889037b53` acknowledged (dispatched 13:00:10Z). Bound strictly to revision 2 + digest `5fba147a…`: digest re-derivation, full r1/r2 diff, schema, r1-preservation, product-issue immutability, explicit `--workspace-id` on every provider call (carried open finding), and the duplicate-variant note. Evidence reuse limited to unchanged assertions per the accepted r2 gate scope.

Next: C3 verdict → VERIFIED ⇒ governance decision binding recordKey/version/digest, then c4combined (persist+readback / replay / lost-ack, all binding `5fba147a…`). REVISE/FAILED ⇒ DEFERRED fallback per decision path; correction budget stays 1/2.

Note: my verify@2 package text contains an Orchestrator mention link for the return-event instruction, which queued one extra orchestrator run — it will fan-in, find nothing new, and exit quietly. Parent stays `in_progress`.
